nom: Pacifica Glow Baby Brightening Peel Pads 10% AHA + BHA

avis.texte: Cannot say enough, stay away. Gave me hives and husband broke out too. The worst.
It makes my skin glow and feel amazing. My husband told me my skin looked amazing after using it

If you want serious drying power, serious dermabrasion feel, this is for you. This item doesn't mess around. I use a pad to wipe my face and once I am done, my fingers that held it also feel like oil and skin cells have gone bye bye. The dirt you don't see is now on the pad. This is serious business and not something for daily use. I use this especially on my T zone to get rid of excess oil. It's dope. I would highly recommend it. It has a pleasant enough smell. It has lasted a long time for me. Great buy!

I used it for 2 days and it burned my skin. If it burns you please stop using and wash your face with water. Just because it burns it does not mean its working ugh! My mistake. Left me with burned marks on my face and neck. It might work for some but not for all skin types.
This one will leave you absolutely glowing. I cannot be without it. It helps clear blemishes, within days they dry up and disappear. I wake up each morning, after using it, confident in my skin.
This is a very good product and has strong ingredients. I'm only taking a star off because it says you can use up to three times a week, I would not do that unless you have severe acne or need it!

I like these peel pads and I got a good sale on them, which was an absolute bonus. I use them in my chest where I have some discoloration from sun damage. They have already lightened up the discoloration where I can visibly see it, so I'm happy. Will buy again , do wish they were a little bigger, but they are effective and that's the most important part.

avis.titre: Love it, but could do without the essential oils
avis.texte: Really loved the way these made my skin look. Definitely exfoliating like it claims, but I wish it didn't contain essential oils.

These peels are amazing for a quick glow up! I use them whenever my skin is feeling a little dull, and by the next morning - voila! Easy to use and while you can feel it, I didn't find it overly irritating or drying.

avis.titre: Leaves skin very refreshed - nice scent
avis.texte: Very nice smell and it left my skin feeling very hydrated. Theres also a good amount in the container
It took me a little bit to find these pads again. I really liked them a lot and I am grateful that I have some again

I love these AHA pads! I use them at night on my non-shower days to take off makeup and give my skin a pick-me-up between showers. I've been using them for a few years now and I will continue buying as long as they're available.
Overall like the product is really good. The scent is way too strong!
One of my favorite Pacifica products! Not too harsh on my skin compared to physical exfoliants, and leaves my skin feeling so smooth and actually glowing. I love it!

avis.titre: Leaves residue and breaks me out
avis.texte: I usually love pacifica and was excited to try this as a more affordable alternative to the first aid beauty pads but its been about 3 months of using this and I find its kind of sticky or feels heavy and clogging and ive been breaking out more than ever. Not for me.

One off the best products I've used for my acne. I had one of THE WORST breakouts I've had in a long time. A coworker recommended this product. I was skeptical but tried it. It not only cured my break out, but my skin hasn't been this great in so long. So smooth, less breakouts
Best shortcut for super clean skin. These pads are my go-to for camping face to "ugh, my skin needs an extra something for clean and bright". The smell yummy and tingle perfectly.
I liked this product as a base line into exfoliating pads. I am trying others before I repurchase this product. I am glad they never dried out.
Non-toxic brightening peel pads? Yes, please! This together with the Brightening Face Lotion and your face will thank you!

I'm so glad I decided to try these! They make my skin so smooth and glowy! I haven't had any irritation with these, and I have fairly sensitive skin! The best beauty product I have tried in some time!

Great way to use active acids in a gentle manner. I use these at night 3x week, then use a physical scrub in the AM to remove any dead skin. Great for killing bacteria in other places, like underarms and feet.

I actually love these for the most part - they are affordable and a nice combination of actives. I bought them without a careful read of the ingredients list, though, it didn't notice that they have fragrance. I won't buy them again for that reason. There's really no reason to add perfume to a peel/ exfoliating product. I would love to see a fragrance free version.
These are excellent cleansing and brighter cloths! I use in the morning after washing and they have given me a great glow! I'm 64, so I've tried them all. I'm impressed with this product!

I've been using these for over a year and they are AMAZING!!! I am almost 40 with acne prone clogged skin and these give me a glow like I had in my youth plus keep my acne at bay. I'm obsessed and I hope they never stop making these.
For the price of this product it works really good. My skin is usually really congested and I have notice my pores have gotten smaller and the texture of my skin is smoother.
The pad glided across my face and it felt light with a mild smell.
These are my facorite, they keep me coming back for more. I have tried so many toners ane this one is the best one so far!!
Great results after one treatment! Easy to use! I get so many compliments on my skin. I stopped wearing makeup. Lashes and lipgloss

avis.titre: Make my face feel smooth and clean
avis.texte: I am really loves these little pads. I can feel the difference the next morning and you can feel them working after application. Almost bought a way more expensive version and I am glad I didn't.
Can't say enough about how wonderful this is. Use it after I wash my face and I was surprised at how much dirt and makeup was left on my face. Have just used it a week and can see a difference.
Easy to use. Is diminishing texture on my age spots.I alternate with Vegan Collagen.
Love these little pads! My skin feels so smooth and fresh after using them. Like I've just exfoliated. A bit pricey for my budget, but if you use your coupons well it's manageable.

avis.titre: Glycoli Pads + Vit. C enzyme Scrub
avis.texte: My skin looked dull and was experiencing some flaking though I use moisturizer religiously. Came upon your site and was interested in your plant based philosophy and purchased after taking advantage of a sale. They glycolic pads are so nice and though I associated plant based with being ineffective, that wasn't so. The glycolic acid is making a difference in my skin.Flakiness has already disappeared and skin softer. I also purchased the glycolic and vitamin C enzyme scrub and absolutely love that clean buffed feeling. Very nice products and I will buy again. Wanted to add your serum but it was out of stock :( Definitely want to try.

I purchased this product because my favorite brand was sold out, well now this is my favorite! I had this stubborn sun spot under my eye that wasn't fading away. I had tried musely, good molecules, all types of ahas and other products and nothing! musely brightened up my skin tone in general but the spot was there, not going anywhere. after using these Pacifica pads every other night for about 2 months suddenly I looked at myself in the mirror and that annoying spot was almost gone! I couldn't believe my eyes! I have kept using it and it keeps improving. at the beginning it did dry my skin out slightly so I stopped using it for a week and then I went back to every other night, and that was enough, it never dried me out again. I use it almost every night now and my skin still loves it. I still have another spot on my cheek that's faded somewhat but I would probably need to take medication to get rid of that one and I'm not doing that. so I will continue using this one. if anyone knows of another product that is a bit stronger, please let me know. thank you!

I got these to help clear up some bumps on my chin caused by dead skin and many of them were gone the next morning after my first use. I have very sensitive skin and many allergies (including to salicylic acid) and my skin handled this product very well.
I have been using this 3 times a week for a bit over a week now. After use my face feels refreshed. There is a slight tingling when finished but nothing too irritating.

So I got these just because I saw a lot of great reviews on them. They didn't break me out and they seemed to be smoothing my skin, but my issue was the smell. When I first got these they smelled fresh and clean, but I noticed after about 2 weeks of having them, the smell turned into this weird tangy unpleasant smell. I'm not usually sensitive to fragrances but I just can't deal with how much this new smell gives me a headache. Gonna return probably.
Amazing product, works great on mild break outs. I use at bedtime and my skin glows the following day.
These pads are great for soothing and smoothing my skin. My go to for refreshing after shower care.
This is the first product from Pacifica's skincare that I didn't enjoy. When I used it, my skin felt like it was heating up and became irritated. This product isnt for me or my sensitive skin.

I use this on the bikini area two to three times a week. No burning or irritation and gets rid of ingrowns quickly! I use a mild salt scrub (teals) along with this in my routine and I am super smooth now. It got rid of an angry, persistent boil after just three uses with no pain at all. My face is a lot more sensitive so I have not tried it that way.
Bought it last week for ingrown hairs on my face (I'm a hetero/metrosexual male). Works great and less money than other brands

Pregnancy can do some crazy things to one's body. I had melasma during pregnancy as well as after my baby was born. It worsened with sun exposure even when slathered with SPF 55. I'm not a derm, doctor or scientist but, I can say with absolute certainty, that this product greatly reduced the appearance of the melasma on my forehead. Nothing in my diet, skin routine, or ritualistic application of sunscreen has changed. It's these magical little pads that I use twice a week. Now obviously, everyone's skin and tolerance varies so I can only speak on behalf of my experience but, for me, these brightening pads have been a Godsend for my stubborn, blotchy melasma. I do experience mild tingling after use but I'm pretty sensitive and didn't experience any sort of reaction from usage. I would highly recommend this product but would suggest using once a week to see how your skin responds. Happy peeling 🤗

avis.titre: Great for helping with skin texture
avis.texte: I only use this once or twice a week because it can be a bit drying, but I feel like it's made a difference with how noticeable my pores are and my skin feels smoother.
Overall I would recommend this product. It seems to have good amount of glycolic acid & is affordable. Nice to be able to buy in store.
These pads make my skin sting so badly and it burns everytime i use them. I do have a bit of sensitive skin so i wouldn't recommend it if you do too!

I got these for christmas and didnt use them until a few months later. I regret it so bad because these pads cleared my acne and the dark spots. After working out or just every night I felt greasy, I'd use a pad or two and my skin would be glowy and smooth. I do have sensitive skin but theyve never given me a problem.

I have only used a few times, as directions recommend using 2-3 x week. I definitely notice a difference when I wake up in the morning. They definitely tingle for a minute when applying, but overall very happy with the product.

avis.titre: If you're at least 40 then you're gonna know!
avis.texte: So, as soon as I opened this package and took out one of the pads, the very first thing I noticed is the scent! These smell like TANG! If you're not old enough to remember what TANG is, it was a powder drink mix that was orange flavored. Anyway, that's what these pads smell like. And honestly, it's not very pleasant. I've noticed that these also leave a rather sticky residue on my skin after using them. I will use up the container but won't be repurchasing these. There are others that are more effective without the artificial orange scent these have. I will say they do give a nice glow to the skin, but I just don't like the scent or the fact my face is sticky after using them.

avis.titre: Incredible, Fast Results on Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: I was hesitant to buy this product as my skin is so sensitive. However, my mid-age skin tolerated this beautifully. These pads have quickly evened out my skin tone, closed my pores and softened my face in a few short weeks! I am a forever fan!

I have extremely sensitive skin - I break down in hives often, my skin becomes angry, red and flakes with new products, etc. So, I was hesitant to invest in these pads. However, that hesitation turned to pure joy, as I have watched my skin look years younger with only a few weeks of use! And, I haven't had any problems tolerating this perfect product! As a middle-aged woman, I deal with discoloration, sagging skin and wrinkles. I use these every other night. My skin tone is evening, my skin is much softer and plumper and my wrinkles seem to be melting away! I couldn't be more thrilled with a skin care product - and, I am a total make-up and skin care junkie! Plus, this product is vegan and cruelty free - a total holy grail for the skin and the environment! I will be using these for life!

I wasn't sure about this product when I purchased it, but it really made a big difference in the appearance and texture of my skin. I ran out over a month ago and I can tell my skin is not as nice as when I used this product. Just repurchased so I can get that glow back to my skin!

I received the Pacifica Glow Baby Brightening Peel Pads from Superdrug as a member of the community and I just want to say the results I've received so far are AMAZING. First of all I love how the Peel Pads came in, definitely eye catching, and it contains 60 pads which is also amazing, for me this will last upto a month or even alittle longer. So the day I received this product I just had to use it on the same day. So I followed the directions according to what it says and I saw the difference the next day. So according to the directions apply to clean, dry face and neck. Massage into skin with the embossed side of the pad and DO NOT RINSE. This should be used before going to sleep (PM) at least 3 times a week. This also give a slight tingly feeling as I have noticed, but it's definitely worth it. This also has a fragrance to it which I don't mind. When I used one pad I didn't realise that I applied it on my little cut which I had on chin and it definitely gave me alittle jump as it stung me alittle, but after a little while it went away. I would still say it's definitely worth it if you want to brighten your skin and clean out your pores. This product is 100% Vegan and Cruelty Free which is amazing. 10% AHA + BHA Definitely on purchase list Can't get over how pretty this looks 😍

I bought these about a month and a half ago and they are amazing! They work so well and have changed my skin! No joke! I also love using them on the backs of my hands for aging. Great to use twice a day for me too! Highly recommend them.

Smells absolutely awful, and no matter how good your moisturizer smells you can still smell it. But the pads are super convenient, I love that they are already soaked with the toner, and you get a good amount of product. When using other exfoliating toners so much of the product soaks into your cotton pad. This solves that problem so you don't waste a bunch of product.

I use this at night a couple times per week and wake up with smooth, glowing skin each time. Although my skin is very sensitive and it stings slightly with application, I also wake up with less redness and overall a more even skin tone. 10/10 for me, especially for the price.

I brought this 2 months ago. The texture of my skin has improved. It is very satisfying to see all the dead skins cell being removed from my face, and it also cleans out my pores very easily without feeling like my face is burning.
I started using this product a week ago and I'm loving it! I have acne scars/redness on my face and this is helping me, I can see the difference the next morning after using this.

Immediately after applying my face started to burn. I sometimes have sensitive skin so I tried to give it a minute to see if it subsided but it got worse and my skin started to turn red and rashy! Thankfully I washed it off right away and applied some Aquaphor so help soothe everything and it went away within probably an hour. Really bummed because I was so excited to use this! It was the most painful skin reaction I've ever had to a product.

I've struggled with bacne since puberty (now early 20s F), and this is the ONLY thing that has ever worked for me. I saw improvement with my first use!! Cleared pimples literally overnight (2 days usually for big ones) and helped with overall texture and uneven tone. Literally holy grail; I have never had a back this smooth. Doesn't stain/bleach my clothes or sheets. Smells citrusy and sweet, and chemically; could be overwhelming for some but it goes away pretty fast. Literally love these pads. I haven't tried on my face yet, as I haven't felt the need.

Very pleased with these little powerhouse pads. Years ago I tried a much more expensive brand of peel pads, which also required two separate formulas/applications. With these Pacifica pads I have seen noticeable results after just one use (skin already feels smoother), with a simpler application and much lower price. You can feel the tingle after first applied, but it dissipates pretty quickly.
Great product that was recommended by my dermatologist. I have sensitive combination skin and it's improve my hyperpigmentation.

After using peels and masks, and exfoliation of facial routine skin care, these pads are used for toning and balancing the ph balance in my skin. it doesn't give it a glow, but my skin isn't as dry after routine. it quickly balances and works best when followed by a moisturizer. it reminds me of wittchazel, but formulated with ingredients to help the process of facial skin routine. it gives a nice clean feel. I would recommend this. the smell isn't very strong, and goes away quickly. just a very slight smell. but goes away. I gave it a 4 because it should say can be used as a toner, but would highly recommend it.
strips away dead skin, but leaves skin feeling fresh - not peeled

These are great I purchased them from Ulta and now I came to the Pacifica site to see more things. Definitely a repurchase I'm 55 soon to 56 and these really brighten my complexion and the ingredient list can't be beat.
I really like this product. It works well. The whole 'Glow Baby' line is really good, as are all the Pacifica products.
I love this product. It does exactly what more expensive products do and it lasts a long time.
Love this product! Really helped clear my skin of all small little bumps and imperfections. Definitely in my reg rotation. It can be a bit intense at first so ease into it!

avis.titre: Some Kind of Miracle Product or Something!
avis.texte: I stumbled upon this in the checkout line at old navy! I was suffering with stretch marks on my chest and just overall bad, dull skin because of years of neglect as a caretaker. I decided to buy and THE NEXT DAY saw a complete change in the skin on my chest (above my breasts). I couldn't believe it and showed my niece. She was stunned. Ever since then Pacifica has become my favorite skin care—just ordered like $259 worth of products because every single thing I've used has been remarkable!
These smell terrible. I thought they would smell like the glow baby serum (orange cream) but they stink like moldy wood. I can't even use them. Going to have to throw away.

I was using medical grade complexion pads and decided to try a more economical option. I'm 47 with normal to oily skin. I use these daily and my skin is brighter. I can feel it working and I haven't had an issue with them being sticky.

avis.titre: This will make you break out !
avis.texte: I tried this BHA pad, I use several AHA/BHA products. But wanted an easy-use pad instead of the cream. After the 1st use, my face broke out into blisters with an itchy rash. I had to go to my doctors and get a steroid patch and Itching cream to cure it. It's been a week and it is still not gone away. I have normal to combination skin. And never once has anything ever done this to my face. Buyer BEWARE
These have a slightly funky smell, but I'm used to it now. They leave my skin feeling smooth and not overly dry.

After reading so many positive reviews, I really wanted to like this. But alas, these Glow Baby pads are not for me. I've got 50+ year old slightly oily skin. These leave a sticky film, & zero benefits. Glad this work for others - I'm disappointed.

avis.titre: Yes I most definitely would buy this again!
avis.texte: It's gentle and not so harsh, you feel a slight tingle that is manageable! I've only been using it for a week along with prep pre-wash, the vitamin c serum, face lotion and face wash. I can't wait to see my results 🤗 so excited!

avis.titre: Great price, but not for dry skin
avis.texte: I have rather dry skin, I live in a dry climate, and perhaps the mix of that just caused my skin to have huge dry patches on my cheeks. This was the only new product I've added into my regimen, so its gotta be this. So bummed! The price was great, but not for dry skin. It also caused my fingers to peel! it is crazy, I guess it's too strong for me.

I bought these thinking they were similar to another brand which I couldn't find but after using the whole container, my skin feels and looks the same. they do irritate a bit but after some calming serum it goes down. I wanted to love because I like the brand but ill try something else

I absolutely love the ingredients! Its not irritating and it helps calm the skin even with the different acids. Very cleansing, exfoliating and leaves the skin much brighter and hydrated looking over time.

I'm on my second jar of these pads. I could not be happier with the amount of exfoliation these provide. They get rid of dry flakey skin. After a week, they got rid of some mild bumpy texture on my forehead. When my skin barrier is healthy, these do not burn at all. When my skin barrier is a little off, these only burn a little. There is a little redness after use for me, but it goes away quickly. As a child of the 80s who used those acne pads, I really love pad products. These are super convenient and mess free. Smell like an orange creamsicle. I'm not saying these are a one stop magical cure all for every skin care need, but they are a really nice addition to your exfoliation routine. I wouldn't want to be without them. I use them 3 times a week and moisturize afterwards.

This was the solution to my foundation separating from my nose constantly. These are great for skin care prep before makeup. The smell isn't overwhelming either. Very good product! Just make sure you use a good spf (like the ones by La Roche Posay)

So pleasantly surprised by these pads!! I've only been using them for two weeks and my skin is GLOWING! They're strong enough that I notice a difference and yet I haven't had any dryness or irritation from using them 3 days a week! And the price point for these is superb. These have become a new staple for me

I've been using these pads for a week and WOW. It cleared up my pimples and I've had an incredible improvement in my skin tone and scar reduction. I'm in my mid-40's and have had constant acne for years due to hormone imbalances. I've tried so many things and this seems to be the only thing that really works. THANK you for this product and please don't ever discontinue it!
I love using this product. It works on the first pad. My skin is clear and more bright and vibrant. The price is great! I will continue to buy this product!

I have been using these pads for a little over a month now, no more often than 3x a week. I haven't seen a change in my skin texture or pigmentation. I don't think they make my skin any "brighter." I like the scent and it doesn't make my skin burn or tingle though. I will continue until the pads are gone, but will not likely purchase again.

avis.titre: The best Pacifica product out there (anymore)
avis.texte: This is the only product Pacifica makes that I can't live without. The other was micellar water, but that ship has sailed. I used to use Pacifica everything but they keep changing everything because their focus is on marketing and not on product. While I have largely moved away from Pacifica as my main brand, this product comes highly recommended. I really hope that they keep this one around.

Love, love, love! This makes my skin feel so smooth and clean! I use it every other night, sometimes nightly. It is not harsh or irritating for my oily skin. I like the light scent, not over powering. The pads are a nice texture. You really glow afterwards. I am 41 and this makes my skin look smoother and firmer. A new staple in my medicine cabinet that I highly recommend. I don't even feel the need for foundation anymore.

I originally bought this because I have coarse, curly hair that is prone to ingrowns, irritation, and dryness after shaving. I was going to buy the first aid beauty bump eraser, but I saw online that this would do the same thing for half the price - and that is 100% true (they both have the 10% AHA). This product has changed my life!!! I basically have no ingrown hairs now, and when I do get them they practically unravel themselves. I also use this on my face because I had a lot of hyperpigmentation and acne scarring and this has helped with the fading process and reduced my acne flare ups.

I just starting using these pads last night and tonight and it burns so bad, the left side of my face is super red it's likes like a have a rash. I don't like this at all! My skin is very important to me and Im scared if I keep using this I'm going to have bad looking skin. I don't know if I am allergic to something in here but I don't like it.

I've been using these for a couple of years now and I do have sensitive skin, but I wanted a toning pad. These were affordable and were similar to ones I've used before. These clear my face up within one use and after several uses my skin is smoother and my breakouts are gone. This whole line is amazing.

avis.titre: Omg these pads made my skin feel amazing!
avis.texte: I used one of these in conjunction with the Glow Baby Vitaglow lotion, and within a half hour I could feel my skin get so much tighter and smooth! I ordered the mini sizes just to try to them out and I am blown away. Will definitely be ordering the full sizes! ❤️❤️

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: this is my second purchase, makes my skin soft and glowing, my pores have diminished!

avis.titre: Gave me pimples for the first time in 5 years
avis.texte: My skin is not sensitive and I haven't had any changes in my diet or routine, so I blame it on this product. I used it overnight and my skin started to break out very badly and itch. I never have any reaction from any product or food that I consume, so I'm beyond upset.

I've used The Ordinary peel in the past but it was just too strong for my skin and was very irritating. I bought these and wondered how well they would work considering you can use them every other day and the price. My skin is super hormonal (hello pregnancy) but after one use my skin was so soft and smooth! I will say that I did have some purging but that's to be expected if your skin is bad and you use an exfoliator like this. It just bought everything to a head and after a few uses my skin is doing a lot better! I follow up with a vitamin C serum and a good moisturizer. It may be strong if you've never used something like this but if you've had bad reactions to the peel I mentioned above, I would highly recommend this!
Amazing product at an affordable price! Definitely will keep using this product. A bit of a lemon, lime smell with a hint of cedar which dissipates quickly. Easy to use. I use this every 3 days.
I use this at the end of the day after I've washed my face. Skin looks so bright. Love the Glow Baby line

It seems there's an ingredient I'm allergic to in this. Used it last night for the first time, woke up this morning with the area around my cheek bones red, itchy, and puffy. It seems a few people have a reaction to these pads. If you're using them for the first time maybe try them out on a night when you know you don't have anything planned for the next day.
Natural economical peel pads. I need exfoliation, antioxidants.
I've only used a couple so far but, WOW. Feels so good-and makes you glow

I was having some new trouble with texture and dullness. I bought these pads bc they were on promo, and boy I was glad I did! I saw immediate results the next morning in my skins appearance and definitely had a luminous glow. After about 2 weeks of consistent use I get compliments about my skin again. Def will be repurchasing.

It's been about 3 weeks since starting the pads. I use them between 4-6 nights a week and I have already seen such amazing results. My skin is so much brighter already! And literally glowing…. I want to buy this entire line.

I am a professional makeup artist and I use these on almost every client. They are great at toning the skin, evening it out, and creating a radiant base to begin makeup on. I also love that they are Vegan, Cruelty Free, and made in the USA! That is an ultimate win in my book. I've had several clients ask what I used after I used these because they also make your skin feel fresh and toned. Highly recommend!!!

I've been using these pads in conjunction with the Wake Up Beautiful Overnight Retinoid Cream, and my skin has never been smoother. I feel like I also notice a little more brightness. I would definitely purchase again!

I really wanted to love this! I wanted toner pads for exfoliating and this fit the bill. But after a week of solely testing this out it caused raised, red bumps all over my forehead and temples. I knew it was this since nothing in my regime changed :( might be some ingredient in it. But I would've kept it if I didn't have a reaction!

avis.titre: Love the Results, Not the Smell
avis.texte: As a 45/F W/slightly oily, mild rosacea on cheeks, easily turns red, sensitive skin, I was leery to try these on my face. I had used a similar product years ago by Dr. Dennis Gross, with beautiful results, so I took the plunge. I'm very impressed with the results! I use 1-2 pads, a quick sweep over the face, focus on nose, cover neck/décolleté as well. The next morning I wake up with soft, evenly toned, happy skin. I personally go every other day with this treatment. I would give this five stars, but the smell is not very pleasant. I'm happy that it wears off quickly, but the initial smell is like a "sour" orange popsicle. I'm ready to try a few other skincare products by Pacifica.

I have been using these pads on my body anywhere I've noticed red spots or bumpy skin (mainly legs and butt) and it really works well! This is the first chemical exfoliant I've tried on my body and I'm so happy with the results so far. Bonus: helps reduce the chance of ingrown hairs!
I simply can not believe how well these work…and for that price!! After only a week I could see a HUGE difference in my skin. Looks clean & clear, lit within. I am stocking up!!

I have been using Pacifica cleansers for years. I was excited when they came out with this Glow Baby line and finding a less expensive alternative to other exfoliating pads I had been using (First Aid Beauty and Kinship). These caused me to have tiny, raised, itchy blisters on my forehead and cheeks. I noticed them after I started using these pads and the cleanser. Went on vacation for 7 days, stopped using them, my face cleared up. When I came home I used them again, rash/blisters appeared again. Test complete, verified the culprit. Since I stopped using them completely my skin looks 100% better: clear, no rash, no itchiness or redness.
